headline: First Light | Senco Gold

highlights: Revenue growth was supported by festive demand, healthy SSSG and elevated gold prices.

Gross margin declined 480bps YoY to 12.2% which led to EBITDA margin contracted 260bps YoY to 4.4%, primarily due to discounting, higher customer acquisition and promotional spends, along with increased old-gold exchange.
However, PAT growth was supported by a sharp increase in other income to Rs 1.19bn (vs Rs 0.17bn in Q2FY26), led by gains on gold hedging positions linked to customer schemes, including FlexiGold.
Management expects H2FY27 revenue growth of >25%, EBITDA margin of 7.5- 7.8% and PAT margin of 4–4.5%, with Q3 and Q4 revenue growth guidance of at least 25% and 20%, respectively.
valuation: Senco added 24 stores during FY27 so far, exceeding its initial annual target, and remains focused on franchise- led expansion across Tier 2/3/4 markets.
Over the long term, Senco is targeting Rs 200bn revenue, 8% EBITDA margin and 15% stud ratio by FY30.
We roll forward our valuation to Sept'28E and revise our target multiple to 16x P/E (from 20x earlier) to factor in the moderation in margin expectations with a revised TP of Rs 374.
watch: Lightweight jewellery, 9K/14K offerings and product innovation remain key priorities, while diamond jewellery demand is expected to improve during the upcoming wedding and Valentine's Day season.
